rivieramaya.overview: The Riviera Maya is small and swell-dependent, with waves mostly arriving from the east and southeast. Occasional windswell from winter cold fronts or storms creates small, choppy waves on beach breaks like Playa Delfines in Cancun. It suits beginners on longboards when a swell hits.

months.1: Powerful North Atlantic swells light up the expert reef at Coxos with 8-12 ft faces. The water is about 55 F, requiring a 4/3 mm wetsuit.
months.5: The North Atlantic storms quiet down, leaving smaller 3-5 ft waves that suit intermediates along the Cascais coast.

months.3: Swells begin to ease slightly but still provide solid 5-10 ft faces on the southwest coast. Jardim do Mar remains a demanding break for advanced surfers, while intermediates might find manageable days at Fajã da Areia on the north coast.

edinburgh.overview: Cold, consistent winter surf and mellow summer waves can be found on the North Sea coast east of Edinburgh. Belhaven Bay in Dunbar, 45 minutes away, is a beginner-friendly beach break with local surf schools. An hour away, Pease Bay provides a punchier beach break for intermediate surfers.

months.1: Winter storms bring the most consistent windswell to the north and south coasts. Kamikaze near Cefalù is a rocky point that works only on rare winter days, while Palermo's beaches are beginner-friendly. The water is 57 F, requiring a 4/3 mm wetsuit.
months.2: Winter storms bring the most consistent windswell to the north and south coasts. Kamikaze near Cefalù is a rocky point that works only on rare winter days, while Palermo's beaches are beginner-friendly. The water is 57 F, requiring a 4/3 mm wetsuit.
months.3: Storms become less frequent as spring approaches, reducing the size and consistency of the swell. Kamikaze rarely breaks now, though the Palermo beaches still see ridable days at 2-4 ft.
months.10: Storm activity increases, bringing more regular swell to the island. Kamikaze starts to work on rare days for experienced surfers, and the water is still a mild 70 F.
months.12: Winter storms bring the most consistent windswell to the north and south coasts. Kamikaze near Cefalù is a rocky point that works only on rare winter days, while Palermo's beaches are beginner-friendly. The water is 57 F, requiring a 4/3 mm wetsuit.

sicily.overview: Sicily gets real Mediterranean windswell in winter, with a mix of beach breaks for beginners near Palermo and the rocky Kamikaze point near Cefalù, which breaks only a few times a year, for experienced surfers. It is a quiet, low-key scene that relies on storms, so consistency is low compared to ocean coasts. Summer is flat.

months.1: Winter swells pound the coast, creating heavy, powerful beach breaks at Enderts Beach for experts. The water is freezing, and strong rips are a constant hazard.
months.2: Winter swells pound the coast, creating heavy, powerful beach breaks at Enderts Beach for experts. The water is freezing, and strong rips are a constant hazard.
months.4: Late-season swells offer smaller, less consistent waves at Enderts Beach. The heavy shorebreak remains a challenge for intermediate and expert surfers.
months.10: The winter surf season brings solid swells to Enderts Beach. Intermediate and expert surfers find powerful, cold waves and heavy shorebreaks.
months.12: Winter swells pound the coast, creating heavy, powerful beach breaks at Enderts Beach for experts. The water is freezing, and strong rips are a constant hazard.

redwood.overview: Heavy, cold-water beach breaks for intermediate and expert surfers line Enderts Beach and the surrounding Del Norte and Humboldt County coast. Winter swells from October to April bring powerful waves, but the environment is rugged, with strong rips, logs in the lineup, and documented great white sharks. The water is 48-57 F year-round, requiring a 5/4 mm hooded wetsuit with boots and gloves.

puerto-rico.overview: Warm water and consistent winter reef breaks define Puerto Rico's west coast around Rincón. Domes is a fun right-hand point for intermediates, while Tres Palmas is an expert-only big wave reef that needs a large winter swell. The main season runs from November to April when North Atlantic swells hit the island.

months.3: The northeast swell window is still open but consistency drops, with waves mostly in the 3-4 ft range on the reefs. Intermediate and expert surfers can still find quiet peaks at West Passage.

palau.overview: Remote, uncrowded reef breaks in Palau suit intermediate and expert surfers during the northern hemisphere winter. The main waves are Santa Maria at Angaur, a boat ride of about two hours from Koror, and West Passage near Babeldaob. There is little to no surf industry here, so visitors must bring their own shortboards and navigate shallow reefs.

namibia.overview: Skeleton Bay at Pelican Point, on the peninsula north of Walvis Bay, is a legendary, heavy left-hand sand-bottom tube that experts travel the world for. Reached by a 4x4 track or boat, it needs a very large winter swell to work. Beginners will find little to ride on this remote, cold coast.

morocco.overview: Morocco's Atlantic coast, three to four hours' drive from Marrakech, offers world-class right-hand point breaks like Anchor Point and Killer Point for experts, plus the long, mellow peeling waves of Imsouane for beginners and intermediates. Winter brings the most consistent and powerful swells to these rocky points.

months.4: The first solid southern ocean swells reach the southwest coast. Flameballs and Jelly Babies start working at 3-5 ft for intermediate and expert surfers. Water is around 78 F, no wetsuit needed.
months.6: Peak surf season on the southwest coast. Consistent southern swells light up the reefs at 4-8 ft. Experts find hollow sections at Flameballs, while intermediates can navigate Jelly Babies.

madagascar.overview: Madagascar's southwest coast holds remote, uncrowded reef breaks like Flameballs and Jelly Babies near Anakao, suited for intermediate to expert surfers. The season runs from April to October when southern ocean swells hit the coast. Access is difficult, often requiring a boat trip from Toliara, and surf infrastructure is minimal, so bring your own gear.
